name: La Voie de l'arbre
notes: Rather physical climbing style on this sector.
Routes 168 to 173 (Le curé de Miraude + L'enfant de chœur, between sectors 7 and 8): bolting and cleaning pending — poor-quality rock.
routes: Sustained with good rests; the difficulty is at the start in the roof. Both technical and physical climbing along the pillar. Very nice route. Do it onsight.
Very intense over the first three bolts, then pumpy. Fun route that needs strength.
Varied overall. Physical start; the slab that follows is rather technical. Nice route.
Sustained, continuous climbing. Fairly complex route — the onsight is far from a given — and keep a bit in reserve for the overhanging slab at the top.
Starting variant of 160. Sustained. Non-obvious slab on slopers. Makes 160 very consistent.
Crack climbing. Nice route with an original finish in the tree.
Route that wanders through the roofs. Joins the crack of route 160 after the roof. Physical, very enjoyable climbing.
Very athletic climbing that needs core strength and flexibility for the mantel. A must-do.
Finishing variant of route 162. Stay in the overhanging corner when exiting the roof. Physical and very enjoyable. Very exposed overall.
Crack climbing with a traverse under the roof. Original.
Start up a steep crack, then traverse left to reach the crack of route 167. Consistent and exposed overall.
Athletic bridging/opposition moves in a crack.
Starting variant of 165. Very bouldery at the start, with very original moves.
